/private/tmp/jaxpathways-embedding-c01-env/bin/python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
check_path = Path("projects/embedding-model-300m/tests/check.py").resolve()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("c01_check_focus", check_path)
check = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(check)
reference = check.PROJECT / "model.py"
check._check_model(check._load_candidate(reference))
source = reference.read_text()
old = "weights = jax.nn.softmax(scores.astype(jnp.float32), axis=-1)"
assert old in source
new = "attention_probability = jax.nn.softmax(\n            scores.astype(jnp.float32), axis=-1\n        )\n        weights = attention_probability"
renamed = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / "equivalent_attention.py"
renamed.write_text(source.replace(old, new, 1))
check._check_model(check._load_candidate(renamed))
uniform = "weights = safe_allowed.astype(jnp.float32) / jnp.maximum(\n            jnp.sum(safe_allowed.astype(jnp.float32), axis=-1, keepdims=True), 1.0\n        )"
mutant = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / "uniform_attention.py"
mutant.write_text(source.replace(old, uniform, 1))
try:
    check._check_model(check._load_candidate(mutant))
except AssertionError:
    pass
else:
    raise SystemExit("uniform-attention mutant unexpectedly passed")
print("reference PASS; equivalent renamed/formatted candidate PASS; uniform-attention mutant REJECTED")
